segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Yeah, so thanks for making time, Dana. Your current subscription runs through August 31, and I wanted to walk through the renewal and the extra seats before your finance close next week.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Appreciate it. We’re at 42 users today. I need to add eight more for the regional managers, but I don’t want them live until September 9.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: That works. The renewal would be 50 seats total, September 1 through August 31 next year. Using the annual prepay rate from the pricing sheet, it comes to $48,600 before tax.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Okay. Is that still net 30 on the invoice? Our AP team is pretty strict about that language.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Yep, net 30, PO number on the invoice, and we’ll reference your existing master agreement. No change to the liability or data terms.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Good. For go-live, we need single sign-on checked by September 5. Same domain, no new security review, just adding the managers.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Got it. I’ll put September 5 for SSO validation and September 9 for the eight new seats to be enabled. Our onboarding coordinator can join the kickoff on September 3 at 11 a.m. Central if that still works.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Yeah, that slot works. Send me the order form today and I’ll route it with the PO request. If procurement has a question, it’ll probably be around the seat count only.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: I’ll send the order form with 50 seats, $48,600, net 30, and the September dates right after this. If you can get signature by Friday, we’ll have everything ready well before the 9th.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Sounds good. I’ll watch for it and reply if finance needs anything cleaned up.
